A middle-class family in Somnath relies solely on their grocery store for income. Faced with financial challenges, they unite to save the store and work together to pay off its debts.
Virat is an IPS officer who loves Pakhi deeply. However, things become complicated when he has to let go of his love, Pakhi, and marry Sai.
Khushi, everyone's favourite, unwittingly connects with conman Krishna through a wrong number, sparking an unexpected journey of love and adventure.
Mitti Kapoor Malhotra navigates personal and familial challenges as allegations against her husband test trust, love, and the pursuit of justice.
